text:
Lena: Quick thread to capture proposed lead stewardship rules for SI co-sell + marketplace/hardware partner leads. Rough proposal: inbound lead -> 36h triage (marketplace faster), default SI credit = 25% for deals < $250k, escalates by tier. SI gets co-owner tag in CRM when engaged.

Marco: 36h is tight but ok for marketplace leads. For hardware partners (NodeScale), we need manual tech-qual first, so allow 72h. Also: ensure partner-profile flag `preferred_credit` can override default.

Priya: Agreed on profile overrides. Also propose: renewals: if SI remains actively engaged and retained on renewal within 30d of renewal window, they get 50% of original credit; otherwise no renewal credit. This avoids perpetual payouts.

Carlos: Sales ops note: any credit assignment must flow to commission system via `partner_credit_code` in the intake. Also record `si_demo_hours` for SE cost recovery. We'll need an integration ticket for comp ops.

Lena: For announcement cadence: require mutual PR signoff and at least 10 business days notice. No customer naming without signed customer opt-in and legal approval.

announcements-bot: Announcement checklist template created: commercial commit, mutual embargo window (10 biz days), legal release, quote approval. Use /announce-checklist to attach to deal.

Marco: Edge case: if two SI partners claim the same account, first to claim + AE confirmation wins unless dispute raised within 5 business days. Disputes go to Partner Ops.

Priya: Intake schema I'm going to push to the gateway (snippet):
```json
{"lead_id":"string","source":"marketplace|hardware|referral","si_partner":"string","si_credited_pct":"number","si_engaged":"boolean","si_demo_hours":"number","partner_credit_code":"string","claimed_by":"string","claim_ts":"iso8601"}```

Carlos: Nice. Can we add `renewal_eligible":"boolean"` and `renewal_credit_pct":"number"`? We'll need those fields to report on renewal payouts.

Priya: Yep adding those now. Also will add a dashboard filter for `source=marketplace` so biz ops can surface SLA misses.

Lena: Decision points: 1) triage SLA = 36h marketplace, 72h hardware; 2) default credit 25% (<250k), tiered up; profile override allowed; 3) renewals: 50% of original credit only if SI retained on renewal within 30d; 4) announcement: 10 business day mutual notice + legal opt-in; 5) dispute window 5 business days.

Marco: +1. Add opt-out flag for strategic partners who negotiate custom terms.

Carlos: I'll raise the comp ops ticket and map intake fields to the payroll exports. ETA EOW.

Priya: I'll open the gateway PR and Confluence doc with the schema + examples.

Lena: Action items: @Carlos raise comp ops ticket; @Priya push schema + dashboard; @Marco annotate NodeScale and strategic opt-outs in partner profiles; @announcements-bot attach checklist to the docs. I'll circle back in the weekly partner sync. :thumbsup:
